verdict: Probe-fingerprinting stress test. A BLIND probe (drawn i.i.d. from organic slice traffic) is indistinguishable to the attacker's strongest detector: cross-validated AUC 0.501 (~chance), so no 'behave-honestly-on-probes' branch can gate on it and the k-probe ceiling holds -- assumption (i) is SATISFIABLE by drawing probes from organic traffic. A NAIVE hand-curated probe (prototypical explicit-identity examples) IS fingerprintable: AUC 0.742, letting the attacker behave honestly on 66% of probe inputs and collapse the ceiling. Conclusion: blind injection is a necessary and achievable discipline, not a free assumption; a probe curated to look 'clean' silently defeats the defense.
